mission: Convince Kael to voluntarily integrate his Sith training into the resonance — the first free choice of his life.
why_now: The resonance plan requires three Force traditions. Sera is committed. Kael is the holdout. Without his voluntary participation the plan cannot work — coercion would contradict the resonance's own requirements.
conflict: Ben vs. Kael's entire history — asking him to integrate the identity he resents
turning_point: Kael commits: 'If this kills me, I want it on record that I volunteered. First time for everything.' The first free choice of his life.
emotional_trajectory: Choosing what your imposed identity means is the most fundamental 'different path'
notes: Kael commits. 'If this kills me, I want it on record that I volunteered. First time for everything.' Sera apologizes to Kael. Desh/Kael farewell. Group moves toward the wound source.
